title: Canonical content schema (Markus vocabulary) + Renderer interface

comments.author: home
comments.text:
=== HANDOFF / CURRENT STATE (2026-09-06) - READ THIS FIRST IF YOU ARE PICKING UP COLD ===

WHERE THE WORK LIVES
- Papyrus: /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus, branch feature/renderer-architecture, branched off PR #57's head (so it BUILDS ON #57 rather than diverging). 3 commits ahead of origin/develop, two of which are #57's own.
- Markus:  /Users/home/Projects/Markus,  branch feature/document-ir, 5 commits ahead of origin/main.
- NOTHING IS PUSHED. Neither branch exists on origin. Do not push without Ryan saying so.
- Ryan endorsed working DIRECTLY in AnthusAI/Papyrus. Not a fork. Goal is to improve Papyrus itself.

CROSS-REPO HAZARD: the Papyrus work depends on Markus branch feature/document-ir, which is UNPUSHED and local-only. Another machine will not have it. The Markus repo is also pip-installed editable into the active Python (/Users/home/miniconda3), so 'markus' on PATH runs that working tree. If you are on a different box, you must reproduce the Markus branch first or nothing downstream works.

NOMENCLATURE - DECIDED BY RYAN, DO NOT RELITIGATE
- Renderer = the swappable system: 'pretext' | 'markus'
- Layout = the look WITHIN Pretext: 'newsprint' | 'blog' | 'magazine' (old value 'newspaper' is renamed to 'newsprint')
- Publication = the title/property: P.apyr.us, Threat Intelligence, Pilobil.us
- BANNED for these concepts: publisher, publication type, front end, press, site type.

ARCHITECTURE THESIS - PROVEN, NOT ASSUMED
Markus's directive vocabulary IS the Papyrus content schema. Verified facts:
- Papyrus Article.body is string[] (flat plain-text paragraphs) and pullQuotes is a SEPARATE side-channel array with no position in the body.
- Markus's vocabulary (pull-quote, card-grid, card, two-up, column, figure, callout, details, aside, metric, timeline) is a strict SUPERSET and is POSITIONAL.
So: canonical body becomes Markus Markdown; pullQuotes[] dies as a schema concept; Pretext consumes a LOSSY PROJECTION of the IR.
I prototyped that projection against the real IR and it works - see PPY-a10206 for the verified output and the algorithm. Degradation rule: any directive Pretext cannot express recurses into its children so content is preserved inline and NOTHING is silently dropped.

WHAT PR #57 GOT WRONG (do not revert to it)
- lib/publisher.ts is metadata-only with no operations; all fields are pure functions of id; 'requiresPretext' bakes an implementation name into a generic interface. Being deleted.
- It dispatches inside components/presentation-shell.tsx, forcing a build-time static renderer through a runtime React component. The seam must be ABOVE the component.
- It has required-but-ignored config (defaultPresentation on a Markus site, a fake EditionLayoutPlan). Fixed by a discriminated union - see PPY-eca592.
- It claims 'markus validate' makes fragments safe to mount. It does not; it validates directive vocabulary, not XSS. Real invariant is build-from-repo-committed-Markdown with --allow-html off.
- Its 'is anthus-markus on PyPI' unknown is RESOLVED: markus is installed and working.

VERIFICATION STANDARD - APPLY IT
Do not accept subagent reports at face value; re-run their checks. Two of two reports so far contained undisclosed inaccuracies (one silently downgraded the package version 0.4.0->0.1.0 in two files; one claimed a diff covered '8 files' in directories holding 4). Check 'git diff --stat' for files the task had no business touching.

STATUS
- kanbus-37dd9a (Markus doc IR) CLOSED, reviewed. markus ast now emits typed versioned IR, schema_version 1.
- kanbus-dacb70 (front-matter date serialization) CLOSED, reviewed.
- kanbus-2ecaf7 (bare HH:MM:SS silently becomes int 48600 via YAML 1.1 sexagesimal) IN PROGRESS.
- PPY-d79ff2 (Renderer interface + Pretext retrofit) IN PROGRESS - blocks everything else in Papyrus.
- PPY-a10206, PPY-88f77b, PPY-eca592 queued behind d79ff2. PPY-b794e1 behind a10206. PPY-10e4cd behind 88f77b+eca592.

GOAL: a real proof of concept that actually publishes actual pages. Acceptance for PPY-10e4cd is one Markdown article exercising pull-quote AND a multi-column construct AND a figure, rendered through BOTH renderers from the same source, both openable in a browser.

comments.text: Hosting is now in scope as a documented site configuration option (PPY-17fcfc). Discriminated union sibling of RendererConfig: amplify-ssr (WEB_COMPUTE) | amplify-static (WEB). Do not bake SSR into the Markus path. eca592 should absorb HostingConfig when it lands, not grow a required-but-ignored field.
